ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) field in the medial and central regions. High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips. The left tip features a high-density cluster of dark circular spots within the white field. The right tip shows fragmented white mottling along the outer margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing margin. Profile consists of jagged peaks and shallow valleys with pixel amplitudes varying significantly between the medial and distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex arc towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) scattered across the medial regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites. Corresponding dark circular voids are present on the white left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear marks are visible on the lower medial quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; distinct notches in the trailing edge topography that deviate from regular serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'leopard-spot' pattern on the left fluke tip, characterized by black circular pixel clusters isolated within a high-intensity white background.
